multiple_testing.note: DSR = P(true Sharpe>0) after deflating for n_trials independent configs, sample length, skew & kurtosis. n_trials is a manual UPPER-BOUND of the signal/threshold/window variants explored — overestimating is the conservative direction (de Prado). Bump vector.calibration.n_trials as you try more.

trial_log.note: Point-in-time trial ledger (overwritten each run). n_trials_declared is an upper-bound count of independent strategy configs explored across the hunt, used to deflate the headline Sharpe. Raise it as you try more.

cross_validation.note: Purged + embargoed walk-forward CV (embargo = max forward horizon) replaces the single split_date's leaky boundary. 'robust' = full-sample sign matches `want`, no fold flips, all-but-one folds agree. Stricter than pre/post; both are reported.

probability_calibration.note: Out-of-fold: each day's P(up) is the momentum×risk cell rate fit on the OTHER folds (EB-shrunk, the live mechanism), scored vs realized. brier<base_brier = skill; Platt a≈1/b≈0 = already calibrated. Direction is a near-coin-flip, so calibrated probabilities cluster near the base rate — that is the honest result.

collinearity.note: VIF>5 ≈ redundant (its forward info is already carried by other signals); the high-corr pairs name the cluster. This MEASURES the independent contribution the one-representative-per-axis rule asserts — orthogonalize before any blend.

allocation_bootstrap.note: Circular block bootstrap (21d blocks) of the NET daily strategy returns → 95% CI [2.5, 50, 97.5]. sharpe_gt0_prob = bootstrap P(Sharpe>0). Pairs with the Deflated-Sharpe haircut: DSR deflates the mean, this bounds the variance.
